Indian Stock Markets Trim Gains Midday Amidst Sectoral Weakness

Indian stock markets saw midday trading trim earlier gains, with the IT, Pharma, and Consumer sectors contributing to the decline. Several individual stocks, including Godrej Consumer, Prestige, Hexaware, Swiggy, and Welspun, were noted as making significant moves during midday trading. The broader market trend indicated a pullback after initial upward movement.
